newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwean stocks tumble ahead of budget.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwean stocks tumble ahead of budget.

text.p: Zimbabwe's industrial index tumbled 231.02 points to close at 11,467.81 on Wednesday ahead of Thursday's announcement of a national annula budget.

"The index lost mostly on the back of weaker deals in (blue chip conglomerate) Delta DLTA...it's nothing new, we were expecting it," said one broker, adding that most investors were also taking a breather ahead of the budget announcement.
"Some profit-taking was also there," he said.

Counters to lose on Wednesday included Delta and finance house Finhold which both dropped 100 cents to 2,100 and 700 respectively while construction and plastic investors IHL put off 200 cents to 2,200.
Steel window and door manufacturer Radar and Zimbabwe Sugar Refineries both eased 20 cents to 480 and 1,630 respectively and sugar growers Hippo were down 25 cents to 1,775.

Minings continued lustreless with only three counters trading. Gold producer Falgold and coal miners Wankie were at previous levels but Rio Tinto, another gold company, fell 400 cents to 1,500, pushing the seven share mining index 41.07 points lower to 784.22.
